package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type LessonRevisionProvider interface {
	ResolveLessonRevision(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LessonRevision, error)
}
type LessonCompletionRepository interface {
	GetLessonItem(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningPathItem, error)
	ApplyLessonFact(context.Context, domain.LessonActivityFact) (domain.LearningPathItem, bool, error)
}
type LessonCompletion struct {
	Repository LessonCompletionRepository
	Clock      LearningJourneyClock
}

func (s LessonCompletion) Content(ctx context.Context, studentID, itemID string) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if s.Repository == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(itemID) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	item, err := s.Repository.GetLessonItem(ctx, studentID, itemID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if item.LessonRevisionID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return domain.PublicLessonContent(item.LessonContent)
}
func (s LessonCompletion) AcknowledgeTheory(ctx context.Context, studentID, itemID, requirementID, key string) (domain.LearningPathItem, error) {
	if s.Repository == nil || s.Clock == nil || !validStudentUUID(key) || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(itemID) || !validStudentUUID(requirementID) {
		return domain.LearningPathItem{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	item, err := s.Repository.GetLessonItem(ctx, studentID, itemID)
	if err != nil {
		return item, err
	}
	for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if r.ID == requirementID {
			if r.Type != "theory_acknowledged" {
				return item, domain.ErrConflict
			}
			updated, _, err := s.Repository.ApplyLessonFact(ctx, domain.LessonActivityFact{StudentID: studentID, ItemID: itemID, RequirementID: requirementID, Type: r.Type, SourceID: r.SourceReference.ID, SourceRevisionID: r.SourceReference.RevisionID, FactID: key, OccurredAt: s.Clock.Now().UTC()})
			return updated, err
		}
	}
	return item, domain.ErrNotFound
}

// freezeLessonItems is called only for new assignments. Legacy persisted items
// are carried through with their nullable revision and existing semantics.
func freezeLessonItems(ctx context.Context, provider LessonRevisionProvider, items []domain.LearningPathItem, seed string, current []domain.LearningPathItem) ([]domain.LearningPathItem, error) {
	out := append([]domain.LearningPathItem(nil), items...)
	existing := map[string]domain.LearningPathItem{}
	legacy := map[string]domain.LearningPathItem{}
	for _, i := range current {
		if i.ID != "" {
			existing[i.ID] = i
		}
		if i.LessonRevisionID == "" {
			legacy[i.ReferenceType+":"+i.ReferenceID] = i
		}
	}
	for n := range out {
		i := &out[n]
		if i.ID != "" {
			old, ok := existing[i.ID]
			if !ok {
				return nil, domain.ErrConflict
			}
			if i.ReferenceID != old.ReferenceID || i.ReferenceType != old.ReferenceType || i.LessonRevisionID != old.LessonRevisionID {
				return nil, domain.ErrConflict
			}
			i.FrozenRequirements = append([]domain.LessonRequirement(nil), old.FrozenRequirements...)
			i.LessonContent = append([]byte(nil), old.LessonContent...)
			continue
		}
		if old, ok := legacy[i.ReferenceType+":"+i.ReferenceID]; ok && i.LessonRevisionID == "" {
			i.ID = old.ID
			continue
		}
		if i.ReferenceType != "lesson" {
			continue
		}
		if provider == nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		revision, err := provider.ResolveLessonRevision(ctx, i.ReferenceID, i.LessonRevisionID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		i.ID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d:%s", seed, n, i.ReferenceID))).String()
		i.LessonRevisionID = revision.ID
		i.LessonContent = append([]byte(nil), revision.Content...)
		i.FrozenRequirements = nil
		for _, a := range revision.Activities {
			i.FrozenRequirements = append(i.FrozenRequirements, domain.LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.MustParse(i.ID), []byte(a.ID)).String(), ActivityID: a.ID, Type: a.Type, Required: a.Required, SourceReference: a.SourceReference})
		}
		if err = domain.ValidateLessonAssignment(*i); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
